acceptanceCriteria.text: isMobile threshold raised to 900px — tablets now get full-screen game
Godot stretch mode reviewed and rebuilt for correct phone scaling

snapshot.description: On mobile and tablet, the game renders too small (zoomed out). Root cause: isMobile threshold (768px) excluded iPads (min-dim=768). Fix applied: raised threshold to 900px so tablets now get full-screen layout. Desktop iframe frame height also raised from 75vh/860px to 85vh/1000px. Remaining work: Godot project stretch mode needs review for small phones — requires a Godot rebuild.
snapshot.title: Fix mobile zoom and layout issues across all game screens
